device: tensordem.granular2d 2-D rough-wall plane shear, round-25/26 case

statistics.autocorr: tau_int = 1 + 2 sum_k rho_k (Sokal window), n_eff = n/tau
statistics.stationarity: last two 1-strain blocks agree within 2 sigma AND second-half weighted trend |z| < 2
statistics.saturation: mu = mu_inf + a exp(-gamma/gamma0), gamma0 by grid

decision_rule.PASS_mu: every w = 0.5 point stationary AND |mu - mu_ref| <= 10 % at every I
decision_rule.PARTIAL: stationary but the curve misses the law; report the stationary offset as the device's bias and keep the ledger FAIL
decision_rule.WITHHELD: any point not certified stationary; report the drift explicitly
decision_rule.never: no post-hoc choice of window, pressure convention or I definition after the data are read

declared_limitation: the cited law is a 3-D glass-bead fit; the device is 2-D, so phi is judged on monotonicity only, and mu is judged on the curve-level envelope as well as on the pointwise band
